verdict.rationale: Vanta's questionnaire automation page says it combs your knowledge base of security documentation and previous questionnaires to generate responses for new questionnaires, leaving you only to review, approve, and submit. The Vanta AI Agent is also marketed as completing questionnaires, and API endpoints exist for managing Customer Trust questionnaire responses. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that answers draw on live controls and test data rather than just documents and past questionnaires, deeper docs on the draft-review workflow (confidence, citations, editing), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
